papers.title_en: Ortho2CAD: 3D CAD generation from orthographic drawings using vision language models
papers.authors: Aditya Joglekar, Amit Regmi, Kenji Shimada, Levent Burak Kara
papers.evidence: 明确使用几何强化学习训练视觉语言模型从正交投影图生成CAD
papers.tldr: 工程设计中，正交投影图纸常用于传递设计意图，但下游工作流需要可编辑的参数化3D CAD模型。为此，提出Ortho2CAD，一种视觉语言模型，可直接将光栅化正交图纸转换为CadQuery代码并生成3D CAD。通过监督微调与几何强化学习训练模型，在无真实标签时优化。基于pythonOCC的绘图生成器创建投影图。在多个数据集上，模型生成100%语法有效代码，3D CAD IoU超过所有基线，平均相对提升7%。该方法展示了VLM结合SFT与RL在正交图纸到3D CAD重建中的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Engineering design intent is often communicated through rasterized orthographic drawings. However, downstream workflows inherently require editable and parametrically defined 3D computer-aided design (CAD) models. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ortho2CAD, a vision-language model (VLM) specifically designed to translate rasterized orthographic drawings directly into editable CadQuery code, which can then be seamlessly converted into 3D CAD models. To train the model effectively, we utilize supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for instances where explicit CadQuery code labels already exist, and we apply geometry-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the model in scenarios where ground-truth labels are absent. To enable learning at scale, we create a pythonOCC-based drawing generator that renders first-angle orthographic projections from STEP models, complete with dashed hidden lines and key dimensions. On existing datasets encompassing settings both with and without CadQuery supervision, we generate orthographic drawings and show that our model produces 100% syntactically valid code. Moreover, it achieves a 3D CAD intersection-over-union (IoU) accuracy that surpasses all baselines, with an average relative improvement of over 7% compared directly against the next best performing model. We show that leveraging VLMs with SFT and RL techniques can effectively pave the way forward for orthographic drawing to 3D CAD reconstruction. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/AdityaJoglekar/Ortho2CAD.
